summary: Iteration 167 - Auth fix for customer agimk@me.com and Pre-KYC gate verification. All requirements verified: Login works, user lands on / after login, Pre-KYC gate visible on HomePage and MorePage, /wallet redirects to KYC flow for unverified users.

tests: Post-login redirect to / (not stuck on /login) - PASS
Pre-KYC home gate visible on HomePage - PASS (data-testid='pre-kyc-home-gate')
Wallet page shows KYC verification flow - PASS
More page shows Pre-KYC gate with reduced content - PASS (data-testid='pre-kyc-more-gate')

agimk_login.details: Login with agimk@me.com / Aldink56600 works correctly. User exists in database with email_aliases=['afrimk@me.com', 'agimk@me.com']. Password hash verified.

post_login_redirect.details: After successful login, user is redirected from /login to / (HomePage). URL changes correctly, no broken page.

pre_kyc_homepage_gate.details: Unverified user (kyc_status=not_started) sees Pre-KYC gate on HomePage with 'VOR VERIFIZIERUNG' banner, 'Zugriff bewusst reduziert' message, and buttons for 'Identität verifizieren' and 'Erlaubte Bereiche öffnen'.

wallet_kyc_redirect.details: When unverified user navigates to /wallet, they see the KYC Verifizierung page with 'Identität verifizieren' prompt instead of full wallet view.

more_page_reduced_content.details: More page shows Pre-KYC gate with message 'Vor KYC nur Basisbereiche sichtbar'. Only basic sections visible (KONTO, BELOHNUNGEN & WACHSTUM, APP, HILFE, RECHTLICHES). Wallet, Auctions, Marketplace, Commerce items are NOT visible (restricted).

critical_code_review_comments: User agimk@me.com correctly restored in database with email_aliases for backward compatibility
serialize_user in security.py correctly returns kyc_status and kyc_verified fields
Frontend UserContext.jsx correctly maps kyc_status and kyc_verified from API response
App.js isKycRestrictedPath correctly identifies /wallet as KYC-restricted path
HomePage.jsx shows pre-kyc-home-gate for unverified users (showKycRestrictedExperience=true)
MorePage.jsx shows pre-kyc-more-gate for unverified users with reduced menu items

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 core tests passed, 2 skipped due to rate limiting)
